subject: Clarifying PHI: minimum-necessary fields & evidence required for BAA scoping
messages:
From: Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@healnet.com>
To: ava_chen@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@healnet.com, security@healnet.com
Date: Tue, 22 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PHI scope question for BAA / minimum necessary fields

Hi Ava,

Thanks for the demo last week — HealNet is trending toward Redwood for the clinical notes enrichment flow. Procurement asked us to get clarity on PHI eligibility before we move the SOW to legal. Two quick asks we hope you can confirm for the BAA scoping: 

- Can you confirm whether Redwood Hosted (standard API) is considered eligible for workloads that will contain PHI, or do we need Dedicated/Private?
- For our ingestion path (HL7 -> S3 -> Redwood API), what is the "minimum necessary" set of fields you need to perform entity extraction? We want to minimize patient identifiers sent to your service.
- What specific evidence artifacts do you provide for procurement/security to scope the BAA: dataflow diagrams, retention policy, sample audit logs, SOC 2 report, DPIA notes, etc.?

We're trying to scope our procurement packet this week — would appreciate a concise checklist and any templates you can share. I've attached our preliminary dataflow mapping (healnet_initial_dataflow.xlsx).

Thanks,
Olivia Grant
Head of Clinical Integrations
HealNet Health
olivia.grant@healnet.com

From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@healnet.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com, monica_patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 22 May 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PHI scope question for BAA / minimum necessary fields

Hi Olivia — thanks for the clear list and for sending the dataflow. Looping in Rishi (security) and Monica (CS) so we can give a consolidated checklist. Summary up front: Redwood does not recommend using our public Hosted tier for PHI. For PHI workloads you should plan for Redwood Dedicated or Private (VPC/on-prem) depending on contractual and data residency needs. Details below.

Minimum-necessary guidance for entity extraction (our recommended default):
- Required for decent extraction: de-identified text body (clinical note) + minimal metadata for routing (ingest_id, timestamp).
- Avoid sending direct patient identifiers where possible (SSN, full DOB, full patient address). If you send patient name / MRN for correlation, we recommend pseudonymizing (hashed MRN) before sending.

Evidence / artifacts we can supply for procurement / security:
- Dataflow diagram template (attached: redwood_dataflow_template_v2.drawio) that we ask customers to fill with ingress/egress endpoints.
- SOC 2 Type II summary + PDF excerpt (soc2-type2-summary.pdf).
- Sample audit log extract (redactions applied) showing access and token-level event IDs — we can share after NDA.
- BAA draft (proposed_baa_draft.docx) and DPA language.
- DPIA notes and suggested mitigations (summary provided in intake).

Next steps we need from HealNet to finalize scoping:
1) Confirm which deployment you prefer (Dedicated vs Private).
2) Confirm ingestion patterns (push via secure webhook vs S3 pull) and whether attachments (images/audio) will be included.
3) Approximate monthly volume / tokens per note and retention requirements.

If you can confirm those three items today, we aim to return a redlines-ready BAA + evidence bundle by EOD tomorrow.

— Ava Chen
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ava_chen@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0118

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwoodinference.com>, Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@healnet.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 22 May 2028 13:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PHI scope question for BAA / minimum necessary fields

Folks — quick technical clarifications from security:

- Deployment eligibility: Hosted (public multi-tenant endpoints) is not supported for PHI under our BAA. Dedicated (single-tenant GPU pool) or Private (customer VPC/on-prem) are acceptable.
- Transient PHI: If you require transient processing via Hosted, we need an explicit architectural exception (rare) with signed controls and additional encryption/contractual terms; this typically drives customers to Dedicated instead.
- Minimum necessary fields for extraction: ideally just the clinical text blob + a hashed identifier for result reconciliation. If HealNet needs name/MRN correlation, we recommend maintaining a mapping in your systems and only sending the hashed token.
- Required artifacts for evidence package:
  * Filled dataflow diagram (what you sent is helpful; please annotate ingress auth).
  * Ingress/egress endpoint IP ranges and bucket ARNs.
  * Retention policy for raw and derived artifacts (retain durations). We typically show logs for 90 days by default and can extend per contract.
  * Sample redacted audit log (we will produce a sample showing identity, timestamp, API endpoint, and action).
  * Encryption at rest/per transit descriptions and key management details (KMS/HSM).
  * Roles & access control matrix (who in HealNet and Redwood will have access).

I will prepare a one-page technical checklist and a minimal-necessary field mapping example by EOD. Ava — recommend we attach the SOC2 excerpt and the redwood_dataflow_template to the bundle we return.

-Rishi
Head of Security, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com

From: Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@healnet.com>

Subject: Re: PHI scope question for BAA / minimum necessary fields

Thanks — that is helpful and aligns with our expectations. We've annotated the dataflow and added a column for "can be hashed prior to send" (attached: healnet_initial_dataflow.xlsx). Procurement is happy to receive the proposed BAA and SOC2 excerpt; can you confirm when we will get the redlines-ready bundle? Also attaching our initial list of retention requirements for different artifact classes.

If you can get the bundle by EOD tomorrow that would keep our procurement schedule on track. Also, we'll need a HubSpot deal reference in your response for our legal intake — deal HLN-2028-0423.

Appreciate the quick turnaround,
Olivia
Head of Clinical Integrations
HealNet Health

P.S. Please note: some of our notes include scanned consents and small PDF attachments. Would you prefer those uploaded to a separate bucket and referenced by ID rather than included in the inline clinical text?
